promises.label: Security and resiliency investment
promises.commitment: Aspire to add another $0.5 trillion of lending and deploy $10 billion of incremental direct equity investments through the Security and Resiliency Initiative.
promises.outcomeSummary: Original targets remain pending; JPMorgan reported more than $230 billion financed and facilitated and $5 billion committed from the initial $10 billion equity allocation.

missing.what_was_said: The call also described the $10 billion in direct equity investments as incremental and said they would not happen instantaneously.
Dimon said the $1.5 trillion, 10-year SRI had probably generated more than $200 billion in its first year, while noting the number had not yet been disclosed.
After saying the SRI might be bigger than expected, Dimon said JPMorgan would not provide details on every item every quarter and that investors would have to trust him.

promises.label: 2026 adjusted expense budget
promises.commitment: Hold 2026 adjusted expense to approximately $105 billion, subject to market conditions.
promises.outcomeSummary: The $105 billion outlook—not a spending promise—was revised upward to FY26 implied ~$108.6B, market dependent. Full-year results remained pending.

missing.what_was_said: In Q&A, Jamie Dimon explicitly said, “$105 billion is not a promise. It's an outcome of business results.” He also said that if volumes remained strong and every quarter were as good as the first quarter, JPMorgan would spend more than $105 billion “for very good reason.” This materially qualifies the unchanged forecast quoted in S4.

promises.label: Apple Card integration
promises.commitment: Integrate Apple Card into JPMorganChase systems over two years.
promises.outcomeSummary: Apple Card integration remained pending. The latest filing continued to describe an expected closing date approximately 24 months after the purchase commitment.
